title: Search common furniture surfaces when looking for newspapers
description: Use this when searching for newspapers or similar reading materials in a living room environment.
content: Newspapers are often found on sofas or other seating furniture rather than shelves or drawers. When searching for newspapers, prioritize checking sofas, armchairs, and similar surfaces before exploring less likely locations like shelves and drawers.

title: Move only the currently held object to the target container
description: Use when placing objects into a container after picking them up.
content: When moving an object to a container, reference the object currently in your inventory, not an object already placed in the container. Attempting to move an object that is not held will result in "Nothing happens."

title: Retry failed take actions after examining the location
description: Use when a take action fails despite the object being visible in the observation.
content: If a take action returns "Nothing happens," examine the location to confirm the object is still present, then retry the take action. The failure may be transient, and a subsequent attempt can succeed.

title: Search systematically through storage locations when looking for a target object
description: Use when the target object is not immediately visible and must be located among multiple containers or surfaces.
content: When searching for an object, methodically check cabinets, drawers, and other storage locations one by one, opening closed containers to inspect their contents. Do not stop after finding unrelated items; continue until the target object is located.
